[b]Альтернативний баланс: мережа терміна: [b]Alternative balance: a network of terminals.[/b] «Take into the network» and the cargo waits at the shipper. Pick it up with rounds from your hubs, collect it in warehouses, haul it on trunk runs (your own vehicles or partners) and deliver it around the towns. The more consignments in one run, the cheaper each one: that is the profit. The windows «Cargo» and «Terminals» are your warehouses, runs and lines.

[b]Alternative balance: a network of terminals.[/b] «Take on» and the cargo waits at the shipper. Pick it up with rounds from your hubs, collect it in warehouses, haul it on trunk runs (your own vehicles or partners) and deliver it around the towns. The more consignments in one run, the cheaper each one: that is the profit. The windows «Accepted cargo» and «Terminals» are your warehouses, runs and lines.

[b]Прикордонний конфлікт[/b] з %s. Перев: [b]Border conflict[/b] with %s. Haulage is risky, but humanitarian cargo pays generously.
[b]Як працюють тендери.[/b] Компанія-зам: [b]How tenders work.[/b] A client company hires your vehicles with crews for several months. While the contract runs, these vehicles take no other trips, and you get a fixed monthly payment for each unit. New offers appear at the start of the month with the licence «Freight haulage» and are valid for 3–6 weeks. To sign a tender you need free vehicles of the required type.

Кожен хаб дає робочі місця: 1 рівень 12,: Every hub gives workplaces: level 1 — 12, level 2 — 40, level 3 — 150, a logistics hub — 400. To hire more people, upgrade hubs or open new ones.
Кожен хаб — термінал: [b]склад[/b] (тонн: Every hub is a terminal: a [b]warehouse[/b] (tons), a [b]throughput[/b] (tons a day: what is over it queues) and [b]modules[/b] for trains, ships and planes. «Terminal management»: hub and terminal upgrades, partner transit and [b]routes[/b] from there: click towns on the map, choose the vehicle and how often to repeat.

Every hub is a terminal: a [b]warehouse[/b] (tons), a [b]throughput[/b] (tons a day: what is over it queues) and [b]modules[/b] for trains, ships and planes. Without a module the cargo is transshipped through a partner terminal in the same town — dearer and slower. Partners may carry their freight through your terminal: income, but part of the throughput goes to them.
Кожні 15 хвилин гри в окремий слот — він: Every 15 minutes of play into a separate slot — it is first in the «Load game» list.

Temperature-controlled medicine and vaccines. Yearly audit of warehouses and reefers.

Your hubs and their levels, countries and towns for new hubs.

Найближчі, що вміщують вантаж: The nearest that hold the load

Найбільші тендери світу, балкери, важкі: The world's biggest tenders, bulk carriers, heavy trains, heavy and super-heavy aircraft. The goal: become No. 1.

Renewal is automatic if there is enough money. The price depends on the HQ country and the situation in the world.
Невеликий контейнеровоз до 1 500 т: деше: A small container ship up to 1,500 t: cheaper and faster, calls at any port.
Нез'ясовані втрати %s минулого місяця. Б: Unexplained losses of %s last month. Without a financial director nobody checks the managers.

Опалення, електрика, добрива. Взимку деф: Heating, power, fertiliser. A gas shortage in winter sharply lowers the mood.
Орендодавець дозволяє розширити його лиш: The landlord allows extending it only to level 2
Основа сучасної економіки. Дефіцит гальм: The basis of the modern economy. A shortage slows growth and technology.
Остання новина, що біжить у нижній панел: The latest news running in the bottom bar.

Паливо для АЕС. Потрібне, якщо діє закон: Fuel for nuclear plants. Needed if the nuclear energy law is in force.
Пальне подорожчало на %d%%: світові ціни: Fuel up %d%%: world oil prices jumped
Пальне, хімікати, скраплений газ. Водії: Fuel, chemicals, liquefied gas. Certified drivers, labelling, routes around cities.

Партнер забирає ≈85% оплати вантажів за: A partner keeps ≈85% of the cargo's pay for its part of the way and charges a booking fee: a way not to miss a deadline, while the profit is in your own vehicles.
Перевантаження в місті, де у вас немає в: A transshipment in a city where you have no hub of your own: the hub's owner charges a tax — 4% of the order's pay plus a fee per kind of transport. Open your own hub in this city to avoid it.

The first: %s → %s, still in %s. The rest are in the window «Accepted cargo».

Платформи під контейнери до 500 т, швидш: Container flatcars up to 500 t, faster than an ordinary train. +20% for containers, electronics and parcels.
Повернути вантаж відправнику: Return the cargo to the sender
Повертаються рівними частинами за 24 міс: Repaid in equal parts over 24 months. The rate depends on the rating and the financial director.
Подати претензію через юриста: File a claim through a lawyer

Start — %s. Click towns on the map in turn: where to deliver and where to pick up cargo. Last — a hub or terminal the vehicle takes the rest to. A click on a road between towns is a point the run goes through: that is how you pick your own road. Ctrl+Z removes the last point.
